This visible inner-thigh negative space forms appealing focal geometry, and the close-leg opening is not a wide stance. Even softbox light, a natural 50 mm perspective, neutral posture, and clean true-to-life color keep the focus on garment construction, fit, denim texture, and realistic anatomy.
